messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable, responsive 3D life-simulation game inspired by The Sims, featuring three households with distinct wealth levels and vacation travel.

## Requirements
- Three playable families: ultra wealthy, rich, and average with no connections.
- Preselected homes, clothes, money, jobs, businesses, cars, aircraft, insurance, and related lifestyle details per family.
- Vacation destinations: Singapore, Tokyo, Los Angeles, Doha, Dubai, London, Paris, Milan, New York, and Zurich; selectable Economy, Business, and First Class.
- 3D-style game playable on phones and tablets; no clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game with hand-drawn SVG 3D-style home scenes, no external game engine.
- Household funds, net worth, needs, and day/household selection persist in local storage.
- “No connections” is represented as the average family’s independent starting point; family data is fictional.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive Everlife game dashboard and SVG home scenes in `index.html`, `style.css`, and `game.js`.
- Added family switching, household needs/lifestyle details, work earnings, business earnings, self-care, day advancement, and vacation booking with flight classes and fare checks.
- Verified browser rendering on desktop and a 390×844 mobile viewport; tested family switching, earning, vacation booking, self-care, and day advancement.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- (none)

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. If further changes are requested, continue from the current uncommitted implementation.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page structure and dashboard.
- `style.css`: Responsive styling and modal layouts.
- `game.js`: Household data, gameplay actions, SVG scene generation, travel, and persistence.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- The local game was served at `http://localhost:3002`; browser testing confirmed all 10 destinations and successful booking.
- `screenshots/everlife.jpg` and `screenshots/everlife-mobile.jpg` were created for visual checks.
